purpose: Predeclare the Phase 1 POC evidence requirements before calibration, policy, scanner decisions, or neural/runtime work.

selection_protocol.model_selection: Choose one predeclared configuration using validation only.
selection_protocol.calibration: Fit calibration parameters on calibration only after model selection.
selection_protocol.test: Use once for final confirmation; never tune corpus, configuration, calibration, or policy against test results.

data_readiness.note: A one-percent empirical FPR point remains reportable only when its class/split has at least 100 one-vs-rest negatives.

baseline_selection_targets.fixed_fpr_requirement: Report actual negative support and recall at 10% and 1% empirical FPR. The 10% point is the Phase 1 POC selection gate; the 1% point is a retained operating objective, not a POC blocker.

future_low_false_positive_objective.rule: Keep this stricter target visible in every comparable report. Revisit it with larger independent negative support before a scanner decision or release qualification.

later_calibration_and_policy_targets.rule: Evaluate calibration and abstention only after their separate Python POCs exist; they are not silently inferred from uncalibrated baseline scores.

phase_1_poc_entry: The leakage-safe corpus/split and all baseline_selection_targets must pass. This permits the next Python-only Phase 1 POC, not scanner decisions.
phase_2_entry: A completed Phase 1 POC review plus remaining owner-approved Phase 2 contracts are required. The retained 1% FPR objective remains a release/scanner-decision requirement, not permission to tune on test.
scanner_decision_entry: All applicable data, selection, low-false-positive, calibration, policy, privacy, and later performance targets must pass on final held-out evaluation.
